subject: Refund request - wrong size
body:
Hi there,

The table runner I received (order BC-10391) is too short for our table. I'd like to return it and get a refund please. It's unused and still in the packaging.

Best,
Sofia Nguyen
label: Refund / return
draft:
Hi Sofia,

Thank you for your message about order BC-10391, and sorry it didn't work out. Unused items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund, and we issue refunds within 5 working days of receiving the return. If anything arrived damaged, just send us a photo and we'll refund it in full at no cost to you.
